# Harshith Nayaka L — AI Engineer, Full-Stack

> Full-stack AI Engineer based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India, building AI agents, RAG pipelines, LLM applications, and the production backends and interfaces around them. Currently AI Workflow Engineer at DemandNXT. Available for select freelance projects.

Harshith Nayaka L specialises in the unglamorous part of applied AI — making systems behave the same way on the hundredth run as on the first. Core areas: AI agents and orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM integration, multi-modal pipelines (voice, vision, text), output reliability via schema-constrained generation, full-stack AI applications, backend engineering (FastAPI, Node, Postgres), local and cloud inference (Google Cloud AI, Hugging Face, Ollama), and workflow automation with n8n. Building with code since 2022; reached the semi-finals of the Gen AI Exchange Hackathon 2025 (a national event with 270,000+ developers, organised by Google Cloud).

- [Home](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/): Overview, selected work, capabilities, about, and contact.

## Case studies

- [Creative-Ops Pipeline](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/creative-ops-pipeline): Flagship. A multi-model content pipeline that turns a one-line brief into validated, on-brand output using tiered model routing, schema-constrained generation, QA gates, and failure recovery.
- [CraftConnect](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/craftconnect): Gen AI Exchange Hackathon 2025 semi-finalist. A multi-modal assistant letting artisans run an online storefront by talking and showing instead of typing, built on Gemini and Google Cloud.
- [Maestro](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/maestro): A live, open-source multi-model orchestration engine. A conductor routes one task across thinker/worker/verifier roles over free LLMs and returns a single verified answer with a full, replayable decision-log. Live at https://maestro-psi-neon.vercel.app/
- [Cannon](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/cannon): A daily-driver multi-agent personal assistant — each domain (fitness, work) is an independent specialist with its own persona, tools, and retrieval scope, isolation enforced at the query rather than by convention. Typed provider fallback (Groq→Gemini) makes the whole stack degrade gracefully, including in CI. Live at https://cannon-multi-agents.vercel.app
- [ReplyDesk](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/replydesk): A WhatsApp lead agent that answers every inbound message in ~8 seconds, with a live operations dashboard for the lead feed, pipeline, and response-time KPIs.
- [Nova AI](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/nova-ai): A deployed LLM chat app on Llama 3.1 8B that keeps the API token server-side behind a serverless proxy.
- [BlogSpace](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/blogspace): A live full-stack blogging platform with JWT auth, role-based access, and an admin panel (React, Node, MongoDB).
- [AI Notes](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/ai-notes): A notes app running DeepSeek R1 locally through Ollama, so inference never leaves the machine.

## Published research

- [AI-Powered Note-Taking System: A Local Machine Learning Approach DeepSeek R1 Integration](https://www.doi.org/10.59256/ijrtmr.20250506023): Peer-reviewed paper authored by Harshith Nayaka L, published in the International Journal of Research Trends and Multidisciplinary Research (IJRTMR), Nov-Dec 2025, pp. 178-189. DOI: 10.59256/ijrtmr.20250506023. Documents the local-inference architecture behind the AI Notes project: running a model on-device for summarization, writing improvement, idea expansion, and keyword extraction, reporting 87% user satisfaction on summarization with 1.9-3.8 second response times.
